title: Dr. Stone Creator’s New Shonen Jump Series Ends Before Getting a Chance
content:
Dr. Stone remains one of the most iconic and unique Shonen Jump series even several years after the finale. The award-winning manga is written by Riichiro Inagaki and illustrated by Boichi, and began serialization in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2017. While Boichi is best known for providing the artwork for this fan-favorite sci-fi series, the creator has worked on several manga over the years. Boichi is also famous for providing art and story for several series, including those that have been serialized in Shonen Jump magazines and platforms. His latest work, The Marshal King , sparked quite a lot of hype after its debut thanks to its unique premise.

However, less than two years after the series’ debut, it got axed due to low viewership. The Marshal King featured a post-apocalyptic story with a gorgeous art style that Boichi is known for. Unfortunately, the manga reached its conclusion on October 16th, 2026, with its Chapter 34. The manga went on a hiatus in October last year and returned in September 2026. While the series already had low popularity, the extended hiatus only made things worse. Since the series was bound to get cancelled earlier on, Boichi wrapped up the story in only a month after its return while he continues his work on the spin-off manga for Rokudenashi Blues.

The Marshal King Had a Promising Start, But Couldn’t Live Up to Fans’ Expectations

The Marshal King was by far the most unique series of last year as it focuses on steampunk western themes. The story takes place in a vast, ruined desert wasteland that resembles a futuristic Wild West, following the conflict between chaotic outlaw gangs (desperados) and U.S. Marshals trying to restore law and order. The story centers around Jim Godspeed, a young man and the son of an outlaw, M. Godspeed, who was known as the great villain. For reasons Jim murdered his father and traverses the desert with his body to prove he is the one responsible for the outlaw’s death. The story continues as the truth behind Godspeed’s death and Jim’s real objectives come to light. The series had a perfect balance of mystery and drama, while the art style was just the cherry on top.

Why Was The Marshal King Cancelled?

Shonen Jump series getting cancelled is a common occurrence , even if the publisher doesn’t officially state the reason behind it. The primary reason behind such cancellations is often low popularity and sales, since Shueisha is bound to face certain damage if it continues serializing a manga that won’t catch the reader’s eye. It’s even worse in Weekly Shonen Jump and Shonen Jump +, where the competition is tough and only limited slots are available for creators. If a series isn’t performing well, the publisher will axe it to clear up a slot for other new series that might have a better shot at being successful. The Marshal King had a promising start since Boichi is already a popular character, but the series couldn’t maintain its reader base. Additionally, with the creator working on another project, the hiatus and the sudden cancellation make sense considering his busy schedule.

How do you feel about The Marshal King ‘s cancellation? Let us know your thoughts in the comments!

title: Bleach Officially Ends the Anime’s Final Fight After 22 Years With Epic Finale
content:
It’s taken 22 years of waiting until this point, but the newest episode of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity has officially brought the anime’s final fight to an end with a truly epic finish. Bleach fans have been waiting for over a decade to see the final arc of Tite Kubo’s original manga series to get its own anime adaptation, and the past few years have seen the anime steadily reach this point with the four seasons bringing the final battles to life. Now after an additional month of waiting, the final fight has ended .

When going back to the start of Bleach’ s original TV anime run back in 2004 , it’s been 22 years of Bleach ‘s anime culminating in the release of the franchise’s final two episodes. The first of these two episodes has now hit, and with it brings the fight against Yhwach to its end at last. With lots of events that expand far beyond the scope of the original manga featuring more characters in the middle of the fray, the anime now has the definitive ending to the series overall.

Bleach Finally Ends the Long Fight Against Yhwach in Episode 49

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity Episode 49 picked up right after its cliffhanger before the hiatus last month, and saw Yhwach invading the human world, Soul Society and Hueco Mundo. This was already something that wasn’t seen in Kubo’s original manga version of the finale, but now it’s been expanded a great deal. Not only are even more characters involved as they face off against Yhwach across all three realms, but they help Ichigo to deal the final blow.

The original version of this fight saw Uryu using a special arrowhead given to him by his father to weaken Yhwach enough for Ichigo to deal a decisive blow, and that happens her in the anime as well. But while that’s happening, in Soul Society Captain Kyoraku manages to make it close to Yhwach to touch him and unleash the Right Arm of the Soul King. Meanwhile in Hueco Mundo, Grimmjow and the others piece a blade through Yhwach’s chest. All three Yhwach’s are attacked at the same time, and it leads to his final defeat as originally seen in the manga.

Is the Fight Against Yhwach Really Over?

With how many times Bleach has brought Yhwach back to life after seemingly decisive blows like this, it can be hard to imagine this is truly the end. But with only one episode left, and one final chapter from Kubo’s manga to adapt, this truly is the end of the long fight. The original version of this fight was only about ten pages, and made up of only really 25-30% of the final three chapters of the series. Most of the actual finale is instead spent on exploring the epilogue years after this final bout.

The anime has now made this defeat more decisive than ever before thanks to the way Kubo has been working together with the anime’s production staff to expand on the manga in ways that have elevated the material to new heights. This really is the most conclusive version of the fight, so now all Bleach fans have to do is wait and see how it’s all supposed to end with its final episode next.

How do you feel about the way the Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War ended this fight with Yhwach? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Lezhin Ent. to Launch AI Character Chat Service Teaz in Korea
content:
Lezhin Entertainment will launch Teaz, an AI character chat service based on its webtoon intellectual properties (IPs), on October 19 in Korea.

Announced on October 12, Teaz will allow users to interact directly with characters from original series published on Lezhin Comics and Bomtoon . Users can participate in conversations as one of the characters or interact with them from a third-person perspective.

The service uses officially licensed IPs and features relationship-based conversations in which characters' responses and relationships change depending on users' choices. Teaz will also include game-like collection elements, allowing users to collect hidden illustrations and items created by the original webtoon artists.

Teaz will initially launch as a web service, with a mobile app planned for a later date. Additional features, including a text-based role-playing game mode, will be introduced in stages.

Lezhin Entertainment has not yet stated if it will expand the service into English in the future.

Lezhin Entertainment's parent company, KidariStudio, said it will continue expanding its media offerings by combining content IPs with technology.

The launch follows a broader trend of webtoon platforms using AI-powered character chats to expand reader engagement. In July 2026, Naver WEBTOON launched byUs, a story chat service that lets users create narratives with characters from creator-approved webtoon IPs, beginning with Ctrl+Alt+Resign . The company had previously introduced its Character Chat service in South Korea in June 2024, which surpassed 100 million messages by June 2025, before expanding the service to Japan through LINE Manga in February 2026.

The launches by Naver WEBTOON and Lezhin Entertainment reflect growing interest in AI-powered character interactions as a way to extend webtoon IPs beyond their original stories.

title: Sony Might Have Found Its Next Big Live-Action Anime Movie
content:
It seems like Sony Pictures might have found their next big live-action anime and manga movie adaptation according to a new report, and it’s literally going to have some of the biggest characters yet. Sony Pictures has been quietly in the works on several different live-action anime adaptations over the last few years, and now that it’s further integrating with Crunchyroll, there’s been an increase in the amount of projects that are moving forward in various ways. Especially now that live-action adaptations have been such a hit lately.

According to a new report from reliable leaker DanielRPK , Sony is now developing a live-action feature film adaptation of Naoya Matsumoto’s Kaiju No. 8 series. This franchise has made a big splash in the last few years as while the manga release is only a few years old, the anime adaptation has gotten a worldwide simultaneous release for its first two seasons thus far with even more on the way . This would be yet another massive project in the pipeline.

Kaiju No. 8 Live-Action Movie Rumored to Be in Development

Unfortunately this first report doesn’t come with any concrete details outside of just noting that Sony Pictures Entertainment is developing a live-action Kaiju No. 8 feature film. There are no director or writers attached, nor does it seem to be far enough in development to warrant such an update. This joins a line up of other anime projects that Sony has been working with the last few years like One-Punch Man , Made in Abyss , and even cancelled attempts at adaptations such as with the recently scrapped Astro Boy film project .

There’s a chance that this Kaiju No. 8 feature film project makes it further in development than the others, and it’s likely because it’s been such a recent modern hit. The franchise broke ground with its anime adaptation as it debuted its episodes across the entire world all at once with social media platform X, and kept up that release through its second season. It’s more worldwide of a franchise than many other anime franchises, and its central premise of an older man using Kaiju powers to fight giant monsters seems perfect for a big screen movie .

What’s Next for Kaiju No. 8 ?

Kaiju No. 8 was the top selling manga on Bookwalker this Summer (July 1-September 30), and that’s even more impressive given that Naoya Matsumoto brought the manga to its end last year. But with the manga ended, there is thankfully going to be more of the franchise on the way as Kaiju No. 8 has also announced a final anime release is now in the works. It’s yet to be revealed if this will be a full season or movie, but it will be tackling the final arc from the original manga release when it hits.

If you wanted to check out more of the series right now, you can find Kaiju No. 8′ s first two seasons now streaming with Crunchyroll with both Japanese and English language audio in the meantime. There’s also a special miniseries all about Narumi now streaming for free with its official YouTube channel that has brand new story beats not seen in the manga either.

There’s quite a lot to check out for Kaiju No. 8 , but what do you think? Would you want to see a new Kaiju No. 8 live-action movie? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – DanielRPK

title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Reveals Final Battle Visual Ahead of Last Anime Episode
content:
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War has revealed a new “THE STORIES VISUAL – Final Battle” visual following the premiere of Episode 49, “THE BLADE.” The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25, before delaying the final two episodes to improve quality . It is set to run for 10 episodes, with Episode 9 releasing today. The series finale, Episode 50, will release on October 26.

You can see the new visual below.

Created by Tite Kubo, BLEACH was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and concluded with 74 volumes. The manga has exceeded 130 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.

The original anime adaptation aired from 2004 to 2012 and received four theatrical films. The franchise returned in 2022 with BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , adapting the manga’s final arc. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles.

On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High revealed its protagonists in a new trailer, with the game featuring original character designs by Tite Kubo.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Reveals First Look at a Major Flashback
content:
Black Clover Season 2 is now working its way through the Fall 2026 anime season, and the first look preview images for Episode 4 of the series are teasing Nacht and Yami’s major flashback. Black Clover Season 2 picked up immediately after the first season cliffhanger from five years ago, and Asta and the others have been thrown into an intense set of rematches against the Spade Kingdom’s Dark Triad. But some of the fighters are struggling more than the others during all of this.

One of the key fights for Black Clover Season 2 sees Dante facing off against Nacht and Jack the Ripper, but things took a turn when the newest episode saw the underworld opening up a bit early and unleashing a set of twin Devils that are much stronger than Nacht can deal with. But with the first look at Black Clover Season 2 Episode 4, it seems like this fight gets so intense that Nacht can’t help but think back to his past with Yami and his twin brother, Morgen. Check out the preview images below.

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 4 First Look & Synopsis Revealed

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 4 is titled “The Day of Atonement,” and will be making its debut in Japan on October 24th. Much like the rest of the season, the new episode will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll when it hits for fans in North America and other international territories when it hits. While there are a number of fights happening at the same time, it seems like the majority of the focus is going to be on Nacht’s struggle against the Twins according to the synopsis revealed on the anime’s official website.

“Appearing before Nacht were two of the highest-ranking demons: Nahamah, who wielded demonic fire magic, and Lilith, who wielded demonic ice magic,” the synopsis for the episode teases. “Their magical power was overwhelming, and Nacht could only dodge their attacks and buy time. As Nacht fought with his life on the line, he remembered something from the past. There was a reason why Nacht continued to fight beyond his limits.” Which sets up the look into his past that showcases more of Nacht’s connection with Yami.

What’s Next for Black Clover Season 2?

As the synopsis continues, it seems like Nacht is going to make a gamble with a huge move against the twins that could serve as the only way to take them down, “—Finally, he was in a desperate situation, unable to even touch them. Yet Nacht did not give up, and he ‘united’ with the two demons, making a huge gamble against the highest-ranking demons. What will be the outcome of Nacht’s battle for atonement, linked to his past memories…?” We’ll just have to see how it works out for him.

Black Clover Season 2 has yet to reveal how many episodes it’s going to be sticking around for, but it’s likely not going to be anywhere near the massive 170 episode count seen with the first season. As it speedily makes its way through all of the chaos of the Spade Kingdom Raid arc, now is the perfect time to catch up with it all now streaming with Crunchyroll ( especially now that an English dub is available ).

What are you hoping to see from Nacht in Black Clover’ s next episode? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: EST N8 Picks Up Korean-Animated Film Pilgrims for Worldwide Sales
content:
EST N8, an American entertainment company, announced on October 8 it has acquired worldwide sales rights to Pilgrims , a Korean science-fiction animated feature that screened at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival and won a technical award at the 2025 Bucheon International Animation Festival (BIAF). The company launched international sales at the Asian Contents & Film Market at the Busan International Film Festival, which was held from October 10 to 13.

The film is adapted from a short story in Choyeop Kim's bestselling collection If We Cannot Go at the Speed of Light , which has sold 400,000 copies. It follows Sophie, a resident of an idyllic community where emotional suffering has been eliminated and everyone must spend a year on Earth upon turning 18. When Sophie begins remembering Daisy, a friend who disappeared on Earth, she discovers troubling truths about her village and questions whether a life without pain is worth living without love.

Pilgrims marks the feature directorial debut of Pyoungkang Heo, who spent nearly 20 years working in the Japanese animation industry. His credits include the Netflix series Japan Sinks: 2020 as series director and the film Night is Short, Walk On Girl as unit director. The voice cast includes Hyang-gi Kim, Ji-hu Park, and Joo-young Lee.

EST N8 said Pilgrims is the company's first animated feature. The company was formed through the combination of EST Studios and N8 and focuses on financing, sales, and distribution of Asian films worldwide.

The film is adapted from a short story in Choyeop Kim's bestselling collection If We Cannot Go at the Speed of Light , which has sold 400,000 copies. It follows Sophie, a resident of an idyllic community where emotional suffering has been eliminated and everyone must spend a year on Earth upon turning 18. When Sophie begins remembering Daisy, a friend who disappeared on Earth, she discovers troubling truths about her village and questions whether a life without pain is worth living without love.

Pilgrims marks the feature directorial debut of Pyoungkang Heo, who spent nearly 20 years working in the Japanese animation industry. His credits include the Netflix series Japan Sinks: 2020 as series director and the film Night is Short, Walk On Girl as unit director. The voice cast includes Hyang-gi Kim, Ji-hu Park, and Joo-young Lee.

EST N8 said Pilgrims is the company's first animated feature. The company was formed through the combination of EST Studios and N8 and focuses on financing, sales, and distribution of Asian films worldwide.

title: Welsh & Shedar Anime's Trailer Reveals English/French Dubs' Debut on YouTube on November 5
content:
French entertainment company Ankama began streaming on Monday a trailer for the original television anime Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar (The Azure Legend: Welsh & Shedar ), and it reveals that it will begin streaming the series with dubs in English, Japanese, and French with subtitles in English, French, Spanish, and Portuguese for free worldwide on its new YouTube channel Krosmoz on November 5. The second episode will stream on November 6, and more episodes will debut every week on the channel.

The dubs star (English/French):

• Daniel J. McLean/Sacha Tomassian as Welsh

• Kevin Garcia/Tom Trouffier as Shedar

• Marissa Lenti/Frédérique Tirmont as Zabelle

• Elgin David Aponte/Yoann Bellot-Sover as Joris

• Risa Kageyama/Laëtitia Godès as Bechamel

• Kyle Phillips/Emmanuel Gradi as Kahn Karkas

• Crist Jarrett/Florian Wormser as Asalar

• Christina Groom/Magali Rosensweig as Mama Caroni

The anime's story centers on a country boy named Welsh, and a prince destined to become a king named Shedar. The two boys are from different stations in life, but their destinies intertwine when they try to end a tyrant's plot to conquer the world.

Naoki Horiuchi (episode director for Kingdom second season, Black Clover , Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- ) is directing the anime at Studio Massket . Saori Nakashiki ( Sasaki and Peeps , Tales of Wedding Rings ) is designing the characters, and Nakashiki is also one of the chief animation directors alongside Yoshiaki Tsubata ( Date A Live IV ) and Yuki Ikeda ( WAVE!! -Let's go surfing!! movie trilogy).

Eri Suzuki ( Black Summoner ) is the color key artist, and Studio Massket is also in charge of anime background art. Lucas Cisterne (3D CG for The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash ) is in charge of art setting, Jun Watanabe ( Ascendance of a Bookworm ) is directing the sound at TO Books , and Pierre-Jean Beaudoin & Jose Pavli are composing the music. Tot is credited for the original work, scripts, and drafting the series story outline. Kenichi Yamashita ( MF Ghost ) is in charge of the series scripts for the anime's Japanese version. Takuya Imakado ( The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash ) is the series' monster designer.

Artists Hironobu Kageyama and Masami Okui perform the theme song "Bokura no Mirai e" (To Our Future). Kageyama also performs the ending theme song "Omelette." Kageyama & KUKO perform the insert song "I'm in you."

Ankama is an independent entertainment and digital creation group most widely known for the DOFUS tactical MMORPG, which launched in 2004. The company also published Atsushi Kaneko 's SOIL manga , and Suguro Chayamachi 's Togainu no Chi manga in French.
author: ANN

title: Manga UP! Global Adds Lily of the High Seas, Killer's Familia, The Imperial Court's Floral Stylist, 3 More Manga
content:
Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service added six manga titles in English over the past week:

Title: I Became a Saint to Support My Idol! ( Tenseisha no Watashi wa "Oshi Katsu" Suru Tame Seijo ni Narimashita! ) Creator(s): Natsume Tamayura (author), Yasuyuki Syuri (character designer), Hisaho Aki (manga artist) Release Date: October 10 Summary: Eristella has been reincarnated into the world of a game she played in her previous life. To save her absolute favorite character—Adolf, a knight captain who's doomed to die—she rises through the ranks, becomes a Saint, and even enters into a contract marriage with him! Now that they live under the same roof, will she be able to save Adolf?!

Title: The Abandoned Tamer Signs a Deal With a Devilishly Beautiful Dragon ( Misuterareta Saijaku Tamer, Fūin Sareteita Bishōjo Dragon to Keiyaku Shite Saikyō ni Itaru ) Creator(s): Kazuha Kishimoto (author), Yōichirō Tomita (manga artist) Release Date: October 12 Summary: Noel, an adventurer with the "Tamer" job, is often abused and mistreated by his party due to his lacking combat ability. This culminates in him being left behind in the depths of a deadly dungeon. However, in his darkest hour, he finds opportunity in the form of the Flame Dragon Fran. Noel's job as a Tamer enables him to unseal Fran and become her new master. Bit by bit, his taming skill grants him more and more of her unparalleled power. Between his newfound strength and the new companions they seek out, it won't be long before his old party is left in the dust.

Title: Lily of the High Seas ( Shiosai no Lily ) Creator(s): Naru Seto Release Date: October 14 Summary: Fifteen years ago, Alfred failed to protect his childhood friend from the hands of pirates. Consumed by regret, he dedicated his life to the sea and rose to the rank of a naval lieutenant. But one day when he boards a merchant vessel under siege by pirates, he finds himself crossing swords with the very childhood friend he swore to protect, Lilian. Thus begins a romance of misunderstanding between a straight-laced naval officer and a tomboy pirate!

Title: After Getting the Crap Skill "Poison Immunity," I Ate the Toxic Meat of a Dead SSS-Rank Monster and Awakened an OP Ability ( Hazure Skill "Doku Mukō" wo Ete Tsuihōsareta Tensei-sha, Tamatama Shindeita SSS Rank no Mamono no Mōdoku wo Tabetara Cheat Skill wo Te ni Ireteshimatta ) Creator(s): Nagafumi Yabun (Author), Natsumi Matsushima (manga artist) Release Date: October 16 Summary: Reincarnated into a world where everyone gets one divine skill, Victor draws the short straw with "Poison Immunity." Deemed a failure compared to his "Sword Saint" little brother, he's kicked out of his noble house. At least it's better than being a puppet for his scumbag father, right? But when a cliffside monster attack leaves him staring death in the face, Victor makes a reckless choice: he eats toxic monster meat.

Instead of killing him, something else happens...

"Skill: Heaven Sunder Acquired!"

Turns out, "Poison Immunity" lets Victor absorb the traits and abilities of any monster he eats! Shattering the laws of "one skill per person", the more he eats, the more unstoppable he becomes—one monster meal at a time!

Title: Killer's Familia Creator(s): Ren Kurosaka Release Date: October 18 Summary: Baal and Levi belong to a warrior race known as the horned people. The boss of an assassination familia took them in and raised them from a young age, expecting them to become loyal protégés. Instead, he now spends every waking moment trying to survive their chaotic idea of "family bonding." They'd gladly kill for him—and with their terrifying destructive power and loose morals, they just might kill him by accident! Baal and Levi love their boss, but the boss just wants them gone! Love collides with deadly bloodlust in this makeshift-family battle comedy made up of literal monsters and heartless killers!

Title: The Imperial Court's Floral Stylist ( Kōkyū no Hanayui-shi ) Creator(s): Haruko Yumikaka (author), Sand (character designer), Ema Suzuya (manga artist) Release Date: October 20 Summary: Caomei is a lowly lady-in-waiting in the imperial court. Aside from her daily task of plucking weeds, she possesses a special talent: styling flowers.

These "healing flowers" bloom atop a woman's head as a living symbol of her dignity—as precious to them as life itself. While Caomei once dreamed of becoming a certified floral stylist, she abandoned that hope long ago.

But when a high-ranking concubine arrives with her flowers in severe decay, she begs Caomei for help. Armed with her intricate styling techniques and the mysterious power of her own flowers, Caomei's forgotten gift might just hold the key to saving the entire imperial court...?!

title: Netflix Power Rangers Reboot Costumes Finally Revealed & Fans Are Relieved “Glad This Was Cancelled”
content:
The Power Rangers franchise is current in limbo as its multiple reboot attempts have unfortunately not made it beyond the development stage, but with the concept art revealed for what is likely Netflix’s take on the franchise, fans are glad to see that it was ultimately cancelled. Power Rangers capped off 30 years of the TV series with a few final projects some time back, and has been trying to get off the ground with a brand new take with multiple potential streamers in the time since .

One potential reboot for the Power Rangers series was in development with Netflix back in 2020 with a potential to tie both TV and feature film projects together in a single universe overseen by The End of the F***ing World’ s Jonathan Entwistle, but was scrapped in mid development back in 2024 . Artist Samuel Garcia took to Instagram to reveal that he was given the clear to share some art for a “Power Rangers series that was sadly shelved,” and fans have shared their thoughts on the scrapped project (as spotted by @PwrRnger on X ).

Cancelled Power Rangers Reboot Designs & Concept Art Revealed

While this concept art is not explicitly tied to the previously in development Netflix version of Power Rangers , Garcia’s mention of being involved “a few years back” and the fact that the project was outright “cancelled” does further put it within that window . The Netflix version of the franchise was planned to be overseen by Entwistle back when Netflix was the then exclusive streaming home of releases like Power Rangers: Cosmic Fury and the Once & Always special. But it didn’t make it beyond the development phase despite these designs offering a look at what it would have been like.

Fans haven’t been too keen on these designs, however, as some have noted that they are even glad it was cancelled during its development. The designs also fall in line with some of the rumors about the Netflix Power Rangers project such as its female Red Ranger , who was rumored to have even been cast during its development. The series was touted to be a blend of nostalgic elements with new details for the modern interpretation, and that’s sort of what can be seen here with a streamlined version of the classic suit designs.

What’s Going on With Power Rangers Right Now?

This rebooted version of Power Rangers didn’t make it beyond the development stage with Netflix, and unfortunately that continues to be the case for its latest attempts. There was also a reboot in the works with Percy Jackson and the Olympians showrunners Jonathan E. Steinberg and Dan Shotz for Disney+, but it was cancelled mid-development according to a report revealed earlier this Summer . With no new project in development since, Power Rangers on a whole is currently on ice at the moment.

When it comes to its original Super Sentai materials as well, Toei cancelled the original Super Sentai TV series last year after 50 long years on the air . While there are fans hoping that it’s just going to be a hiatus, Toei has since moved on with brand new heroes. Both Power Rangers and Super Sentai are currently on hold in many forms, but what do you think?

Would you have wanted to see Netflix go through with this Power Rangers reboot? What would you want to see in a new take on the franchise? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – @PwrRnger on X
